channel.title: FortiGuard Labs | FortiGuard Center - IR Advisories
channel.description: The following is a list of advisories for issues resolved in Fortinet products. The resolution of such issues is coordinated by the Fortinet Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT), a dedicated, global team that manages the receipt, investigation, and public reporting of information about security vulnerabilities and issues related to Fortinet products and services.

item.title: Numeric truncation error
item.description:
CVSSv3 Score: 9.6

A Numeric Truncation Error vulnerability [cwe-197] in FortiOS and FortiSASE bgp daemon may allow a configured ibgp neighbor to send malicious/malformed attributes to all connected routers via a specially crafted request

Revised on 2026-11-13 00:00:00

item.title: SSLVPN Improper Certificate Validation
item.description:
CVSSv3 Score: 7.7

An improper certificate validation vulnerability [CWE-295] in FortiOS SSLVPN may allow a remote and unauthenticated attacker to perform a Man-in-the-Middle attack on the communication channel between the SSLVPN web portal and the backend destination website.

Revised on 2026-11-12 00:00:00
